net.proxy_sub: Used for tidebot's own requests (update checks, provider tests, plugins) and for Claude Code. Precedence: manual setting here > environment > system proxy.
net.url_hint: http://, https:// or socks5:// (Clash is usually http://127.0.0.1:7890). user:pass@ is allowed.
net.eff_pac: Direct. Your system uses a PAC script, which tidebot doesn't evaluate; choose Manual and enter the proxy.
net.mirrors_sub: Tried in order when GitHub can't be reached. The manifest is ed25519-signed and every package is sha256-checked, so a mirror can't alter anything; at worst the download fails.
net.presets_note: Third-party GitHub proxies, off by default; they see your IP and what you download and may disappear.
net.e.timeout: Timed out: GitHub can't be reached.
net.e.signature: Update manifest signature is invalid; rejected.
net.e.checksum: Downloaded file failed its checksum; discarded.
net.h.timeout: You probably need a proxy. In Settings → Network pick Auto / system (reads your OS proxy) or enter one manually, then Test. You can also add a download mirror.
net.h.dns: Check your connection; if you use a proxy, set it in Settings → Network.
net.h.tls: A corporate network or proxy may be intercepting HTTPS. Try another network or set a proxy in Settings → Network.
net.h.proxy: The proxy address is wrong or the proxy app isn't running. Check host and port in Settings → Network.
net.h.refused: A network or firewall blocked it. Try a proxy or a mirror.
net.h.http_404: The mirror may not have this version yet. Try later or download manually.
net.h.http: Try again later; if it keeps failing, download manually.
net.h.signature: Nothing unsigned gets installed. The mirror or network may be tampering; switch route or download manually.
net.h.checksum: Nothing that fails its checksum gets installed. Try another mirror or download manually.
net.h.unknown: See the technical details; set a proxy in Settings → Network or download manually.

ws.missing: That folder doesn't exist yet. It is created when the task first runs.
pw.sub: Other browsers and devices will be signed out. This window stays signed in.
pw.too_many: Too many tries. Try again in {n}s
pw.done_n: Password updated. Signed out {n} other sessions
ses.others_tip: Sessions in other browsers or devices. This window stays signed in.
tf.disable_sub_nopw: After this, sign-in no longer asks for a code.
rr.title: Filter by date
rr.empty_sub: Try another range, or clear the date filter to see all.
sp.day_pick: Click to see this day only
sp.day_unpick: Click again for the whole range
sp.day_clear: Back to the whole range · Esc
tf.pol_tip: After {n} failures in a row the task is paused and you're notified.
tf.retry_tip: Only temporary problems (rate limits, network drops, server errors) are retried: first after about 1 minute, then about 5 minutes apart.
tf.catchup_tip: What to do with scheduled runs missed while the computer slept, was off, or tidebot wasn't running.
tf.grace_tip: Runs missed longer ago than this are not caught up.
tf.notify_ok_tip: By default you're only notified about failures, approvals and budget limits.
tf.notify_ans: Include the start of the answer
tf.notify_ans_tip: Success notices carry the first lines of the final answer (Feishu, DingTalk, WeCom, Telegram, the bell and desktop notifications); email gets the whole answer. Turn this off if answers may hold anything sensitive.
tf.streak: Failed {n} times in a row; {m} more and it's paused.
pz.note_breaker: Paused after {n} failures in a row ({c}). Fix it, then Resume; the count starts over.
pz.note_budget: Paused: out of budget. Raise the budget or wait for the reset, then Resume.
pz.note_pack: Imported from a pack, so it starts paused. Check the prompt and schedule, then Resume.
pz.note_plugin: Paused: trigger plugin {p} was uninstalled. Reinstall it or use a schedule, then Resume.
pz.resumed_budget: Resumed; if the budget is still used up, the next run pauses it again
pz.resumed_reset: Resumed; the failure count starts over
pz.why_breaker:
Paused after {n} failures in a row · {t}
Last error: {c}
pz.why_budget:
Paused when the budget ran out · {t}
{r}
pz.why_pack: Imported from a pack: review it, then resume
nt.f_sign_tip: Fill this in if the bot's security setting is "signature" (DingTalk secrets start with SEC). Kept in the system keychain and never shown again.
nt.f_bearer_tip: Sent as Authorization: Bearer <token>. Kept in the system keychain and never shown again.
nt.f_chat_tip: Your user ID for a private chat; group IDs usually start with -100. Message the bot once, then look it up with getUpdates.
nt.f_to_tip: Separate several addresses with commas. Defaults to yourself.
nt.f_port_tip: 465 is SSL; 587 / 25 upgrade to STARTTLS when the server offers it.
nt.f_pass_tip: Kept in the system keychain and never shown again.
nt.gt.failed: Includes timeouts and runs cut short when tidebot quit or crashed.
nt.gt.confirm: Requirement changes to confirm, actions waiting for your approval.
nt.gt.budget: When spend nears a budget (warning) and when it goes over.
nt.gt.breaker: When a task fails too many times in a row and is paused.
nt.gt.finished: Only for tasks with "Notify on success" turned on.
nt.gt.system: New versions, rolled-back updates, low disk space, messages from plugins, and another channel failing repeatedly or working again.
nt.all_note: This channel used to receive every notice; after saving it only gets the ones ticked above.
nt.h.feishu: Group settings → Bots → Add bot → Custom bot, then paste its webhook URL here.
nt.h.dingtalk: Group settings → Bots → Add bot → Custom. For security pick "signature" (put the secret below) or the keyword tidebot.
nt.h.wecom: Group chat menu → Add group bot → New, then paste its webhook URL here.
nt.h.telegram: Create a bot with @BotFather in Telegram to get its token.
nt.h.webhook: Every notice is POSTed to this URL as JSON (event, title, body, …).
nt.test_ok_form: Sent — check the group or mailbox.
nt.last_never_tip: Nothing has gone to this channel yet. Send a test to check it.
nt.off_done: "{n}" turned off; notices won't go there for now
nt.del_body: Notices stop going here, and the saved URL and secrets are removed too.
nt.del_body_tasks: Notices stop going here; the saved URL and secrets, and the rules of {n} tasks that send here, are removed too.
nt.tip_tasks: {n} more tasks send here on their own
nt.err.name: Enter a name (up to 60 characters)
nt.err.url_bad: The URL must start with http:// or https://
nt.err.mail: Enter the sender, recipient and SMTP server
nt.err.groups: Tick at least one kind of notice
nt.err.not_found: This channel no longer exists; refresh the page
nt.err.kind_change: The type can't be changed; delete the channel and add it again
nt.h.email: Type the sender address and the SMTP server and port are filled in for you.
fb.binary: Binary file — can't be shown here
fb.too_large: File too large to show here
fb.none_sub: Download the version as .zip to open it.
fb.preview_tip: Formatted Markdown (external images are not loaded)
be.held: {name}: what's left is held by {n} running run(s) ({used} spent, {held} held, cap {cap})
rd.err_skip_held: Not started: the rest of today's budget is held by runs already going. {why}. They settle at what they actually spend, later runs start normally and the task isn't paused.
sp.held_tip: {n} running run(s) hold {held} (the unspent part of their per-run caps); they settle at what they actually spend.
sp.remaining_held_tip: Cap {cap} − spent {used} − held by running runs {held}. Runs that start together share what's left instead of each overspending it.
sp.cap_tip: Click to change the cap; 0 removes it
sp.cap_off_body: Runs in this scope are no longer stopped by spend and you get no budget notices for it. You can set a cap again any time.
pwr.title: Power
pwr.sub_off: Scheduled runs start whatever the power source.
pwr.sub_low: On battery, background tasks wait for power; at {n}% or below, or with the power saver on, normal tasks wait too. Urgent tasks and runs you start always go.
pwr.sub_battery: On battery, only urgent tasks run on schedule; the rest wait for power. Runs you start always go.
pwr.now_tip:
Read before each scheduled run. Without a battery (desktop, server) or when it can't be read, nothing waits.
A task's priority is set in its form, under Retries & missed runs.
pwr.waiting: {n} task(s) waiting for power: each runs once when you plug in.
pwr.waiting_tip: Unless the task's missed runs are set to Skip, or its catch-up window has passed.
tf.pr_normal: Normal — waits when the battery is low
tf.prio_tip: Only matters on a laptop running on battery (Settings › General › Power). A held-back run shows as skipped and runs once when power is back. Runs you start yourself always go.
rd.err_skip_power_battery: Not started: on battery ({p}). It runs once when power is back (Settings › General › Power).
rd.err_skip_power_low: Not started: battery low ({p}). It runs once when power is back (Settings › General › Power).
rd.err_skip_power_saver: Not started: power saver on ({p}). It runs once when power is back (Settings › General › Power).
tx.import_tip: Import tasks exported on another computer
tx.export_tip: Save as a JSON file you can import on another computer; no working folders, run history, trigger tokens or keys
tx.title: Import tasks
tx.found: {n} tasks in the file, {ok} can be imported
tx.n_renamed_tip: A task with this name exists; was “{n}”
tx.n_provider_tip: This computer doesn't have the file's model access; the default is used, change it in the task later
tx.n_skill_tip: This computer doesn't have that skill; import it on the Skills page, then edit the task to bind it
tx.enable: Turn schedules on as in the file (unticked: all paused, enable after a check)
pz.why_snooze:
Paused by you until {u} · since {t}
Scheduled runs in between are skipped
tpz.title: Pause this task
tpz.note: Resumes by itself. Scheduled runs in between are skipped, not caught up, and triggers or webhooks won't start it; you can still run it by hand.
tpz.note_nocron: Resumes by itself. Triggers and webhooks won't start it meanwhile; you can still run it by hand.
tpz.t_manual: Task paused until you resume it
tpz.t_resumed: Resumed; scheduled runs during the pause were skipped
tz.title: Scheduling timezone
tz.search: Search city, region or offset (e.g. Tokyo, +8)
tz.note: Upcoming scheduled runs move to the new timezone.
tz.saved_moved: Timezone set to {z}; next run moved for {n} task(s)
nt.failing_tip: {n} notification channel(s) failed their last send
ntf.channel_down.t: Notification channel "{name}" failed {n} times in a row
ntf.channel_up.b: Notices it missed are not resent; they are in the notification center.
rx.tip: Export every run in the list (CSV or JSONL)
rx.title: Export these runs
rx.jsonl_sub: One JSON object per line, for scripts
rx.note: Exports every run matching the current filters, search and sort — not just the loaded ones. CSV times are in {tz}, JSONL in UTC; amounts in the display currency.
